mapper.sql: event_id, locale, summary, description, schedule_note, price_note, lunar_date_text, translation_source, status, source_hash, attempts, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM local_event_translations WHERE event_id = #{eventId} ORDER BY locale LIMIT 50

SELECT e.id AS event_id, l.locale AS locale FROM local_events e CROSS JOIN unnest(ARRAY[#{locale}]::varchar[]) AS l(locale) LEFT JOIN local_event_translations t ON t.event_id = e.id AND t.locale = l.locale WHERE e.is_deleted = FALSE AND e.publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' AND e.end_at > #{now} AND split_part(lower(l.locale), '-', 1) <> split_part(lower(COALESCE(NULLIF(e.language, ''), 'vi')), '-', 1) AND (COALESCE(e.summary, '') <> '' OR COALESCE(e.description, '') <> '' OR COALESCE(e.schedule_note, '') <> '' OR COALESCE(e.price_note, '') <> '' OR COALESCE(e.lunar_date_text, '') <> '') AND (t.event_id IS NULL OR (t.translation_source = 'AI' AND (t.source_hash IS DISTINCT FROM e.content_hash OR (t.status = 'FAILED' AND t.attempts < #{maxAttempts})))) ORDER BY e.start_at ASC, e.id ASC, l.locale ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO local_event_translations ( event_id, locale, summary, description, schedule_note, price_note, lunar_date_text, translation_source, status, source_hash, attempts, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{t.eventId}, #{t.locale}, #{t.summary}, #{t.description}, #{t.scheduleNote}, #{t.priceNote}, #{t.lunarDateText}, 'AI', 'DONE', #{t.sourceHash}, 0, #{t.updatedAt}, #{t.updatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (event_id, locale) DO UPDATE SET summary = EXCLUDED.summary, description = EXCLUDED.description, schedule_note = EXCLUDED.schedule_note, price_note = EXCLUDED.price_note, lunar_date_text = EXCLUDED.lunar_date_text, status = 'DONE', source_hash = EXCLUDED.source_hash, attempts = 0, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at WHERE local_event_translations.translation_source = 'AI'

INSERT INTO local_event_translations ( event_id, locale, translation_source, status, source_hash, attempts, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{eventId}, #{locale}, 'AI', 'FAILED', #{sourceHash}, 1, #{now}, #{now} ) ON CONFLICT (event_id, locale) DO UPDATE SET summary = NULL, description = NULL, schedule_note = NULL, price_note = NULL, lunar_date_text = NULL, status = 'FAILED', attempts = CASE WHEN local_event_translations.status = 'FAILED' AND local_event_translations.source_hash IS NOT DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.source_hash THEN local_event_translations.attempts + 1 ELSE 1 END, source_hash = EXCLUDED.source_hash, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at WHERE local_event_translations.translation_source = 'AI'

INSERT INTO local_event_translations ( event_id, locale, summary, description, schedule_note, price_note, lunar_date_text, translation_source, status, source_hash, attempts, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{t.eventId}, #{t.locale}, #{t.summary}, #{t.description}, #{t.scheduleNote}, #{t.priceNote}, #{t.lunarDateText}, 'MANUAL', 'DONE', #{t.sourceHash}, 0, #{t.updatedAt}, #{t.updatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (event_id, locale) DO UPDATE SET summary = EXCLUDED.summary, description = EXCLUDED.description, schedule_note = EXCLUDED.schedule_note, price_note = EXCLUDED.price_note, lunar_date_text = EXCLUDED.lunar_date_text, translation_source = 'MANUAL', status = 'DONE', source_hash = EXCLUDED.source_hash, attempts = 0, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM local_event_translations WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND locale = #{locale}
